cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline coding assistant and autonomous agent for students and developers on an 8 GB laptop. Writes code, uses tools, and runs without a network after download.

test_prompts.prompt: Write a Python function `def two_sum(nums: list[int], target: int) -> list[int]` that returns indices of two numbers adding to target. Assume exactly one solution. Return only the function.
